info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Sale By Commission Id-spec
info.description: This API allows for the modification of sale details associated with a specific commission ID. Designed for financial institutions and banking services, it streamlines the process of updating sale transactions as needed for accuracy and compliance. Typical consumers include developers working on sales management systems and those responsible for financial reporting. The endpoint supports the PATCH method, enabling targeted updates while preserving untouched fields within the sale record.

patch.summary: Update commission details for a specific resource.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the commission information for the resource identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes of the commission based on your requirements.
